records.note: The Southwest Power Pool active generator list at https://opsportal.spp.org/Studies/GIActive shows request ERAS-2025-031 at Kansas City, Kansas, thermal diesel, 150 MW with a nameplate of 165.84 MW, connecting at the Quindaro 161 kV substation, with the Board of Public Utilities as the transmission owner under the code KACY. The request was received on 10/2/2025. The proposed in-service date is 2/29/2028, commercial operation is 5/31/2028, and the interconnection agreement is pending. Capacity is the 165.84 MW nameplate. The grid list's injection figure is 150 MW. The Board's 2024 resource plan has no diesel project. A saved copy of the plan is at https://web.archive.org/web/20250402202525/https://www.bpu.com/Portals/0/pdf/2024-BPU_IRP_Report-2024_11-4-2024.pdf and the live copy is at https://bpu.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/2024-BPU_IRP_Report-2024-FINAL.pdf. Page 5-41 describes Scenario 10 as an "early retirement of the Quindaro 2 and Quindaro 3 oil-fired combustion turbines in 2028". In that case the plan adds 125 MW of solar in 2028 and buys capacity, not new diesel. So the plan does not explain the request, but the 2028 dates line up. Not found: who the request sponsor is, whether it is engines or turbines, and whether the old units retire. Owner is left blank because the grid list does not name the owner of the new unit, and the reviewer may copy the plant owner. The unit name Diesel 1 keeps the new set apart from the plant's existing GT2 and GT3 and its retired steam units.

records.note: The Southwest Power Pool active generator list at https://opsportal.spp.org/Studies/GIActive shows request ASGI-2024-020 at McPherson, Kansas, thermal gas, 123.73 MW with a summer rating of 122 MW and a winter rating of 131 MW, connecting at the Johns-Manville 115 kV substation. The transmission owner is listed as BPU McPherson, Kansas, which is the McPherson Board of Public Utilities. The request was received on 10/30/2024. The proposed in-service date is 3/1/2031 and commercial operation is 6/1/2031. No study status is shown. I found no announcement, rate case or Kansas Corporation Commission filing for a new McPherson unit. The commission's filing site lists three McPherson Board dockets, from 2020, 2021 and 2023, and all are closed. I placed the unit at McPherson 3, the 116 MW unit from 1998, because it is the Board's newest plant in GEM. That is a judgment call, so the reviewer may move the unit to McPherson 2 or make it a plant of its own. The unit may be an addition or a replacement of an older unit. The request does not say. Not found: the technology, the owner of the new unit and whether it replaces a unit. Owner is left blank because the grid list does not name it, and the reviewer may copy the plant owner.
